entities.summary: John-Laffnie de Jager is a South African former tour professional tennis player. A doubles specialist, de Jager reached the semi-finals of three different grand slam tournaments in three different years partnering three different fellow South African players. De Jager is a former non-playing captain of the South Africa Davis Cup team.
